findings.evidence: src/lib/requireUser.ts exports `requireUserId`, an async function documented in the doc's own Purpose sentence as "a helper to resolve the current authenticated user's id on the server (src/lib/requireUser.ts)", but the Key Entities table only lists `authOptions` and `prisma`; `requireUserId` does not appear anywhere else in the document.
findings.locationHint: | authOptions | `NextAuthOptions` object configuring the credentials provider, JWT session strategy, and callbacks (`src/lib/auth.ts`). |
findings.message: The Key Entities table omits `requireUserId` (src/lib/requireUser.ts), even though the Purpose section explicitly names it as one of the three things the lib module provides. Only 2 of the 3 promised entities are documented in the table.
